messages:
maia (security): Jules, auditor ask landed: they want an evidence pack showing RBAC changes + KMS access correlation for past 90 days. They specifically called out Decrypt/GenerateDataKey events and wanted any corresponding incident link.

Jules (auditor): Correct. Deliverables: 1) RBAC_change_list (who/when/what, ticket ref) 2) KMS event extracts filtered to Decrypt/GenerateDataKey 3) correlation table (principalId -> change -> matched event) 4) retention snapshot for CloudTrail bucket. Redact emails; principalId and role arns okay.

vikram (eng-sre): I'll pull CloudTrail/KMS events from the org trail. Plan: run a time-window join where eventTime in [rbac.changed_at, rbac.changed_at +7d]. Also include event.requestParameters.keyId.

maia (security): add policy context: annotate whether the role change was granting any kms:Decrypt or kms:GenerateDataKey permissions. If change was role->policy attach, flag that.

toni (platform): For RBAC source, use iam_audit.events table (postgres) + change_ticket link to Jira. Output CSV columns: changed_at, actor_arn, change_type, delta_permissions, ticket_id, redacted_actor.

vikram (eng-sre): rough Splunk query for proof-of-concept: 
```
index=aws_cloudtrail eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey* | table _time userIdentity.principalId userIdentity.arn eventName requestParameters.keyId resources | sort _time
```
I'll save raw JSON lines for matched events.

Jules (auditor): The auditor wants a short narrative per correlated row (1-2 sentences) explaining why we think the RBAC change is relevant to the KMS event (time proximity, same principal ARN, role permission attach).

maia (security): we'll generate correlation_notes.txt with those narratives. Also include a short statement on redaction methodology.

vikram (eng-sre): on redaction: we'll replace email-like user names with USER-### and truncate S3 object keys to bucket/prefix only. We'll include counts by prefix.

Jules (auditor): Acceptable. Also need proof of retention: show the S3 lifecycle config and the CloudTrail logging config (trail ARN + isMultiRegion + logging status).

toni (platform): packaging plan: evidence/pack_1764321987/ with files: RBAC_changes_90d.csv, kms_decrypt_90d.jsonl (redacted), correlation_table.csv, correlation_notes.txt, retention_snapshot.txt, evidence_manifest.txt. evidence-bot will sign the manifest.

evidence-bot: starting upload to s3://redwood-audit/soc2/pack_1764321987/ RBAC_changes_90d.csv

vikram (eng-sre): sample KMS event snippet I'm planning to include (redacted):
```
{"eventTime":"2026-01-28T09:12:33Z","eventName":"Decrypt","userIdentity":{"type":"AssumedRole","principalId":"AROAEXAMPLE123","arn":"arn:aws:sts::999888777:assumed-role/data-access/xyz-session"},"requestParameters":{"keyId":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:999888777:key/abcd-ef01"},"resources":[{"ARN":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-prod/embeddings/...REDACTED..."}]}
```
I'll replace object keys with prefix notation in the exported JSONL.

maia (security): one more auditor ask: for any matched Decrypts that align with a vulnerability triage or incident ticket, include the incident id and one-line summary. Do not include playbook steps or PII.

Jules (auditor): we just need linkage and a short IR summary line. Good.

vikram (eng-sre): note: joining by principalId can be noisy because of short-lived role sessions. We'll join on assumed-role arn as well and include our confidence flag: exact (arn match), proximate (principalId match within window), low (only same account).

toni (platform): evidence_manifest.txt will include filenames + sha256 + redaction notes. We'll also include a small machine-readable correlation index (CSV) but redacted, per policy.

vikram (eng-sre): ETA: I'll run exports and correlation, upload filtered JSONL + CSVs. Should have presigned link ready in ~90min.

evidence-bot: upload_complete s3://redwood-audit/soc2/pack_1764321987/ RBAC_changes_90d.csv sha256: e3b0c442...

maia (security): thanks team. After upload I'll review manifests and add the short narratives. We'll then hand over the presigned link to Jules and set TTL 7 days.

Jules (auditor): sounds great. Please include contact for a 30-min walkthrough once we deliver so we can spot-check formats.

maia (security): will do.

vikram (eng-sre): posting presigned link when ready.
